name: ChatGPT
tagline: The world's most popular AI assistant.
desc: The benchmark AI assistant developed by OpenAI. Excellent for writing, editing, brainstorming, summarizing, and programming. Powered by GPT-4o, it is fast and supports text, images, code execution, and advanced voice interaction.
pros: Advanced voice mode feels incredibly natural
cons: Can hallucinate on complex mathematical problems
Free version is rate-limited during high traffic

faq.question: Can I use ChatGPT for coding?
faq.answer: Yes, ChatGPT is highly capable of writing, refactoring, and debugging code in dozens of programming languages.

name: Claude
tagline: Best for long-form writing and coding.
desc: Anthropic's flagship model, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, excels at deep analysis, technical writing, coding, and multi-document analysis. Features a massive 200K context window that is perfect for books and large code projects.
pros: Artifacts workspace for live code previews
cons: No native image generation capability
Strict hourly message limits on the Pro plan

faq.question: How much text can I upload to Claude?
faq.answer: You can upload up to 200,000 tokens, which equals roughly 150,000 words or a 500-page book.

name: Jasper AI
desc: An enterprise-grade marketing platform built to write blog posts, email campaigns, ad copy, and social posts. Features brand voice training so it sounds like your company.
cons: No free tier option
Expensive for solo creators

name: Copy.ai
desc: Great tool for generating product descriptions, email sequences, and social media posts at scale. Generous free plan for small creators and marketing teams.
cons: Not as good at long-form analytical writing

name: Grammarly
tagline: The gold standard for grammar and tone editing.
desc: Works across your browser and desktop apps to provide real-time spelling, grammar, and clarity feedback. Generates rewrites based on tone preferences.
pros: Seamless integration with Gmail, Docs, Word
cons: Premium plan is billed annually

name: Notion AI
tagline: AI integrated directly into your workspace.
desc: An add-on for Notion users that summarizes pages, generates draft outlines, adjusts tone, and extracts key action items from meeting notes.
cons: Requires an active Notion subscription

name: Midjourney
tagline: The absolute best AI image generator.
desc: The industry benchmark for photorealistic and highly detailed AI images. V6 produces unmatched quality. Historically runs in Discord, but web alpha is launching.
pros: Strong custom styles and zoom capabilities
cons: Steep learning curve inside Discord
No free tier available

name: DALL-E 3
desc: OpenAI's image generator. Known for exceptional prompt compliance and text-rendering capabilities inside images. Fully integrated into ChatGPT Plus.
pros: Good at rendering text inside images
cons: Images can sometimes look too 'AI-generated'
Limited daily creation quota

name: Stable Diffusion
tagline: Powerful, local, and open-source AI art.
desc: An open-source image generation model that can be run locally on consumer graphics cards. Offers absolute control with no subscription limits or censorship.
cons: Requires high-end PC hardware (NVIDIA GPU)
Technical setup is difficult for beginners

name: Adobe Firefly
desc: Trained exclusively on licensed content and public domain images, making it fully safe for commercial brand use. Powering Photoshop Generative Fill.
cons: Artistic quality lags behind Midjourney V6

name: Leonardo.ai
tagline: Excellent for game assets and brand assets.
desc: A creative platform featuring custom model tuning, prompt helpers, and canvas editing. Great for creating consistent character concepts and product mockups.
pros: Generous free tier with daily refreshes
Train custom models on your own images
cons: Interface can feel overwhelming to beginners

name: Runway Gen-3
tagline: The professional standard for AI video.
desc: A creative suite offering Gen-3 Alpha, an advanced model generating high-fidelity, highly controllable video clips from prompts or images. Used in movie studios.
cons: Free rendering credits run out quickly
Occasional physical glitches in complex scenes

name: Sora
desc: A text-to-video model capable of creating 60-second scenes with detailed camera movements, multiple characters, and consistent background physics.
pros: Generates very long scenes (up to 1 minute)
cons: Currently in limited rollout / high cost
Struggles with action-reaction logic sometimes

name: HeyGen
tagline: Create professional presenter videos with AI.
desc: Bypasses cameras and actors by generating high-quality presenter videos from text. Offers ultra-realistic custom avatar cloning with natural voice matching.
pros: Hundreds of templates and pre-built actors
cons: Monthly limits on standard plans are low

name: InVideo AI
tagline: Turn text prompts into full social videos.
desc: Generates a script, picks stock video scenes, adds an AI voiceover, and compiles captions in minutes. Great for rapid TikTok and YouTube Shorts scaling.
pros: Massive database of stock footage integrated
cons: Stock video clips can look generic

name: Descript
tagline: Edit videos by editing the transcript text.
desc: A transcription-first video editor. Edit your recordings by deleting words in the auto-generated text transcript. Features 'Overdub' voice replacement.
pros: Editing video via text is incredibly fast
Studio Sound feature removes 100% background noise
cons: High CPU/RAM demand on the desktop app

name: Cursor
tagline: The modern AI-first VS Code fork.
desc: The premier code editor of 2026. Merges full VS Code extensions with custom agentic models. Features Composer mode to edit and create code across multiple files.
pros: Deep codebase index lets AI understand everything
Composer mode writes code across files autonomously
Import VS Code settings and keys in 1 click
cons: Premium models query limit on free plan is small

name: GitHub Copilot
desc: Developed by Microsoft/GitHub, it fits into VS Code, JetBrains, and Visual Studio. Auto-completes lines, writes functions, and fixes terminal bugs.
cons: Doesn't edit multiple files together as easily as Cursor

name: Replit Agent
tagline: Build and deploy full applications from text.
desc: Describe your web app idea in natural English and Replit Agent installs dependencies, builds databases, writes code, and deploys it automatically.
pros: Zero local developer environment configuration needed
Deploys live database-backed apps in 2 minutes
cons: Pricing scales up quickly for compute memory usage

name: Windsurf
desc: Built by Codeium, Windsurf features the 'Cascade' engine which runs agent tasks autonomously. Allows developers to edit and review code cooperatively.
pros: Cascade agent operates autonomously and safely
Generous query allowance on free plans
cons: Ecosystem is slightly newer than VS Code forks

name: Notion
desc: Organizes your projects, wikis, and database notes. Its deep AI integrations allow summarizing, outline drafting, and auto-filling databases.
cons: Can get slow when loading very large pages

name: Otter.ai
desc: Joins calls on Zoom, Teams, and Meet, transcribes conversations in real-time, marks action items, and generates searchable summary reports.
pros: Sends custom summary emails after calls automatically
cons: Monthly free minutes quota is low

name: Make (Integromat)
tagline: Visual app and database workflow automation.
desc: A visually-driven automation tool. Connects 1000+ APIs together. Crucial for building automated pipelines containing ChatGPT models.
pros: Easily parse JSON, loops, and conditions
Much cheaper than Zapier for high volume tasks
cons: Slightly steeper learning curve than Zapier

name: Perplexity AI
desc: Searches the web and writes concise answers containing primary reference citations. Features 'Pro Search' for multi-step reasoning.
pros: Direct citation linking prevents fake facts
Pro search solves multi-layered queries step-by-step
Clean UI replaces standard Google search
cons: Struggles with raw creative writing compared to Claude

name: Gemini Advanced
desc: Features a 1 million token context window. Includes Deep Research mode to browse dozens of sources and compose massive structured reports.
pros: Unrivaled 1 million token context window size
Deep Research mode is incredible for complex topics
cons: Interface is slightly basic
Occasional restrictions on image generations

name: Elicit
desc: Built for students and researchers. Scans millions of academic papers, maps findings, and compiles automatic literature reviews.
cons: Free version features limited search queries

name: Consensus
desc: Ask a research question, and Consensus finds findings backed strictly by peer-reviewed science. Features consensus meters showing scientific agreement.
pros: Consensus Meter shows percentage of agreement
Extracts findings from top-tier academic journals
Superb for fact-checking medical and health claims
cons: Limited usage quota on the free tier

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: The gold standard for natural AI voiceovers.
desc: Generates realistic text-to-speech voiceovers in 30+ languages. Features instant voice cloning, voice translation, and sound effect generation.
pros: Voice cloning requires only 60 seconds of reference audio
cons: Starter plan has tight monthly character limits

name: Suno
tagline: Create full musical songs with vocals.
desc: Generates full-length vocal and instrumental music tracks from simple text descriptions of style, mood, and lyrics.
pros: Creates complete songs with lyrics and vocals
Generates tracks in any musical style
cons: Struggles with rendering extremely fast vocal lyrics

name: Whisper
desc: OpenAI's open-source voice transcription model. Features incredible accuracy across 100+ languages. Free to download and run locally.
pros: Incredible accuracy even with heavy accents
cons: No hosted interface; requires terminal/API usage

name: Gamma
desc: Creates fully-styled presentation decks, documents, and web pages from text. Built-in card layout system is highly responsive.
pros: Creates designed presentation decks in 30 seconds
Modern vector layouts instead of boring PPT slides
Easily embed interactive files and videos
cons: Limited design tweaking control for pro designers

name: Salesforce Einstein
desc: Salesforce's AI database CRM system. Analyzes pipeline risks, writes outbound sales responses, and predicts customer deals outcomes.
cons: Requires complex enterprise integration setup
Very high cost for small teams

name: Tome
desc: A responsive presentation tool for creating client pitches. Builds slide cards, compiles layout illustrations, and embeds live data charts.
pros: Excellent canvas layout logic for web previews
Beautiful built-in AI image helper tool
Seamless integrations with Figma, Miro, Looker
cons: Not standard PowerPoint format (slides are scrolled)
